name: Machino Plastics Limited
about: Machino Plastics Limited manufactures and sells plastic injection moulded automotive components in India. It operates through two segments, Plastic Injection Moulding Parts and Moulds & Dies. The company offers front and rear bumpers, instrumental panels, garnish cowl top centers, painted front body kits, grill radiators, aluminium pre colored garnish bumpers, guard side sills, lining fender FR/RR, under hood parts ranges, engine covers, air intake manifolds, air filter covers, fan shrouds, griller radiator lowers, absorber front bumpers, quarter trims, trim center pillars, trim trail ends, cover floor consoles, HCV covers, and panel and box rear floor consoles, as well as ash boxes, front box floor consoles, foot rests, panel instrument clusters, AC vents, and glove box assembly products for four wheelers. It also provides panel side covers, engine cooling duct housings, cover frames, and leg shields for two wheelers; and corner vanes, grill fronts, toolboxes, and side covers for commercial vehicles. In addition, the company manufactures moulds and dies. Machino Plastics Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Gurugram, India.
